name: testsmt19.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (x Ref)(r_1 Int)))))
(declare-sort X) (declare-const mk-X X)

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-X (sel-X X))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-X ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-X (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-X ((this Ref)) X
  (sel-X (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-X ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-X this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.x: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!x ((this Ref)) Ref
  (x (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.r_1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!r_1 ((this Ref)) Int
  (r_1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Methods for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.one ((this Ref)) Int
  1
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!one ((this Ref)) Int
  1
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class X:
; ------------------------

(define-fun X.f ((this Ref)) Int
  (TopLevelDeclarations!one 0 )
)

(define-fun X!f ((this Ref)) Int
  (TopLevelDeclarations!one 0 )
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!r_1 this) (X.f (TopLevelDeclarations!x this) ))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert326))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-X (TopLevelDeclarations!x this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert327))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class X:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-X X)
(declare-const const-2-X X)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-X const-1-X))
        2 (lift-X const-2-X))
  )
)
smtModel:
;; universe for X:
;;   X!val!1 X!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun X!val!1 () X)
(declare-fun X!val!0 () X)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x X)) (or (= x X!val!1) (= x X!val!0)))
;; -----------
(define-fun const-2-X () X
  X!val!0)
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (_ as-array k!3))
(define-fun const-1-X () X
  X!val!1)
(define-fun k!3 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-X X!val!0)
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-X X!val!1)
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 1))
    null))))
(define-fun k!0 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  null)
(define-fun k!1 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 1))
    null))
(define-fun k!2 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-X X!val!1)
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 1))
    null)))
